tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, so no build type is exempt from it. The project also records that HTTPS is used everywhere with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
